name: web-dark-lavender-savings-site-with-outlined-keyword-and-chart-cards
title: Black savings-app page on a lavender field with a hand-drawn ring around 'growing', floating chart cards and a mobile version
whatItIs: A lavender canvas with a black desktop page and a black phone: a pill nav with a lavender button, a headline 'Your money, quietly growing in the background' with an oval outline around 'growing', a lavender CTA, avatars and stars, floating dark cards (round-up saved, total savings with a line chart, vacation fund) and a features section with dark cards.
whatItMeans: Quiet and trustworthy; dark UI with one lavender accent feels calm and premium.
techniques: Circle one keyword with an oval outline.
Float dark cards around a chart.
Use one lavender accent on black.

vocabulary.definition: An oval outline around a headline word.
A dark card hovering around a hero chart.
One colour used for actions and highlights.
A soft glow under a chart line.
